name: long-session-kit
description: Context meter band plus automatic handoffs for long sessions: at a first context threshold (default 50%), at a second one (default 70%, which also suggests /compact; it never runs it), when the prompt cache is about to go cold, and after an idle period. Handoffs (handoff-<date>.md and LATEST.md) are saved at the top level of the folder the session is linked to; /lsk folder picks another. If that folder is a git repository, add handoff-*.md and LATEST.md to its .gitignore.

threshold.title: Context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Write a handoff once the context window is this full. /lsk threshold <n> overrides it.

secondThreshold.title: Second context threshold (%)
secondThreshold.description: Write another handoff once the context window is this full, and show a toast suggesting /compact (the kit never runs it). Must be greater than the context threshold, otherwise it is ignored (/lsk status says so). 0 turns the second trigger off. /lsk second <n|off> overrides it.

enabled.title: Automatic handoffs
enabled.description: Write handoffs automatically (context thresholds, cache warning, idle). /lsk on|off overrides it.

idleMinutes.title: Idle handoff (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Write a handoff once the session has been idle this long. 0 turns the idle trigger off.

cacheWarningMinutesLeft.title: Cache warning (minutes left)
cacheWarningMinutesLeft.description: Write a handoff when the prompt cache has this many minutes left (idle time = cache lifetime minus this). 0 turns it off.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last response. Ribbon models this as 60.

minTurns.title: Minimum prompts for an automatic handoff
minTurns.description: Automatic handoffs are skipped for sessions with fewer of your prompts than this.

handoffDir.title: Handoff base folder (optional)
handoffDir.description: Leave blank to save handoffs at the top level of the session folder (the default). If set, it must be an existing folder; each project gets its own sub-folder in it. A folder chosen with /lsk folder overrides this. Handoffs may contain confidential information: if the folder is a git repository, add handoff-*.md and LATEST.md to its .gitignore.
